items.title: Claude Code on desktop gets custom themes with mods and animated backgrounds
items.summary: Claude Code desktop can now be restyled by describing a theme to Claude, with a theme-examples plugin to start from.

items.title: fal Agent adds Fable 5.2 and builds playable games from one prompt
items.summary: fal Agent now runs Claude Fable 5.2: describe a game and it generates assets and code and runs the game next to the chat.

items.title: LiteLLM Customer Portal adds per-customer budgets, caps and load balancing for usage-based AI products
items.summary: LiteLLM ships a portal for setting and capping usage budgets per customer and balancing load between them.

items.title: TensorFold 1.2.8: Flint 40B on M5 Macs and 26 to 34 percent faster CUDA prefill at TP=2
items.summary: Release adds Flint 40B-A2.5B on M5 Macs, experimental DeepSeek-V4.1 on Metal and Qwen3 embeddings on CUDA, with the author's own speedups (MLX 8-bit cold prompts about 33% faster on M5 Ultra).

doubt.pushback: Speedups are the maintainer's own numbers; no independent run seen.

items.title: Measured: on a 82 GiB Qwen3.8 Flash quant, extra GPU VRAM gives about 80% more decode speed, doubling RAM about 27%
items.summary: On an RTX 5090 Laptop with Basalt v0.2.1 (105 to 187 tok/s going from 16 to 24 GiB VRAM; 83 to 105 tok/s from 32 to 64 GB RAM), with Basalt v0.3.3 adding 13 to 20% on cold start and long context.

items.title: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v2.1: Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 lead at 58
items.summary: Index upgrades to FrontierCode-AA 2.0 (132 tasks graded on maintainer merge) and Terminal-Bench 4.1, scores fall about 5 points; cost per task varies about 30x among top configurations.

items.title: ParseBench-2 benchmarks 40 document-parsing tools on 6 dimensions and LlamaIndex releases OCRia-1.5
items.summary: Severity-weighted OCR benchmark with 4.3k+ pages; frontier models and specialist OCR tools each win different dimensions, and the author warns the composite score is a simple average.

doubt.pushback: Authors note some feedback on annotations and metrics and say new versions will follow.

items.title: Budget3D: image-to-3D generation at any token budget
items.summary: Image-to-3D model that trades quality against a chosen token budget; collection posted on Hugging Face.

items.title: llama.cpp server gets --moe-cache-mib for an LRU cache of MoE experts in VRAM
items.summary: MoE models too big for VRAM can keep hot experts cached on the GPU with one flag, and Unsloth's prebuilt has an auto size option.

items.title: Hermes Agent adds hermes backup and hermes import to move config, skills and sessions as one zip
items.summary: One command archives an agent's config, skills, sessions and data, another restores them on the same or a new machine.

security_forwarded.matched: Cursor (stack.json Cursor CLI) and always_forward agent tooling plus supply chain; update to the Oct 29 Claude Code extension incident (source post https://x.com/cursor_ai/status/2121411147714970092)
